meta.name: PSX Sector Seasonality & Cyclical Alpha Matrix

statusDefinitions.ACCUMULATION WINDOW ACTIVE: Calendar accumulation window open and price in the lower 45% of its 3-year range.
statusDefinitions.OFF-SEASON: No accumulation window open; price may also be extended.

meta.method: One observation per calendar month (first session), forward 60/90-session return, pooled per month-of-year across up to 15 years; overlapping windows mean samples are not independent.

sectors.rationale: New model-year launches and post-budget demand peak Aug-Oct.
Year-end deposit mobilisation and clean-up peaks Dec-Jan.
